entities.name: VarRLF-Report
entities.description: A report containing radio link failure information including the cause of failure.

entities.name: rlf-Cause
entities.description: An information element within VarRLF-Report that indicates the specific cause of radio link failure.

entities.name: T310 expiry
entities.description: Condition where timer T310 expires, leading to radio link failure declaration.

entities.name: Random access problem indication from MCG MAC
entities.description: Condition where MCG MAC indicates random access problem, leading to radio link failure declaration.

entities.name: Random access procedure initiated for beam failure recovery
entities.description: Condition where random access procedure is specifically for beam failure recovery.

entities.name: Reaching maximum number of retransmissions from MCG RLC
entities.description: Condition where MCG RLC reaches maximum retransmissions, leading to radio link failure declaration.

entities.name: Consistent uplink LBT failures
entities.description: Condition where consistent uplink listen-before-talk failures occur, leading to radio link failure declaration.

entities.name: Reception of BH RLF indication on BAP entity
entities.description: Condition where IAB-MT receives backhaul radio link failure indication on BAP entity, leading to radio link failure declaration.

entities.name: T312 expiry
entities.description: Condition where timer T312 expires, leading to radio link failure declaration.

entities.name: t310-Expiry
entities.description: Value set for rlf-Cause when radio link failure is due to T310 expiry.

entities.name: beamFailureRecoveryFailure
entities.description: Value set for rlf-Cause when radio link failure is due to beam failure recovery failure.

entities.name: randomAccessProblem
entities.description: Value set for rlf-Cause when radio link failure is due to random access problem.

entities.name: rlc-MaxNumRetx
entities.description: Value set for rlf-Cause when radio link failure is due to RLC maximum retransmissions.

entities.name: lbtFailure
entities.description: Value set for rlf-Cause when radio link failure is due to LBT failures.

entities.name: bh-rlfRecoveryFailure
entities.description: Value set for rlf-Cause when radio link failure is due to backhaul RLF recovery failure.

entities.name: t312-Expiry
entities.description: Value set for rlf-Cause when radio link failure is due to T312 expiry.

relations.description: VarRLF-Report contains the rlf-Cause information element.
T310 expiry condition establishes t310-Expiry as the rlf-Cause value.
Random access problem condition is further guarded by whether it was for beam failure recovery.
Beam failure recovery condition establishes beamFailureRecoveryFailure as the rlf-Cause value.
Random access problem condition establishes randomAccessProblem as the rlf-Cause value.
RLC maximum retransmissions condition establishes rlc-MaxNumRetx as the rlf-Cause value.
LBT failure condition establishes lbtFailure as the rlf-Cause value.
BH RLF indication condition establishes bh-rlfRecoveryFailure as the rlf-Cause value.
T312 expiry condition establishes t312-Expiry as the rlf-Cause value.
